content.short: Nethermind runs Voyager, Starknet's main explorer, with contract inspection, RPC access and STRK staking.
content.description: Voyager is where most people look up a Starknet transaction, contract or account. It decodes Cairo contracts, tracks network activity and shows token transfers, and users can stake STRK directly from it. Nethermind, a major Ethereum and Starknet infrastructure team, runs the explorer. Developers can query the same Starknet data for their own apps and analytics through Voyager's RPC and APIs. It also offers a Starknet API, an MCP server for AI tools and a staking dashboard alongside live network stats.
